name: fairmediator
description: FairMediator.ai is an AI-powered platform designed to bring transparency and fairness to the mediator selection process. We use state-of-the-art machine learning models to help parties make informed decisions when choosing mediators.

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && npm install
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.audit: npm audit && npm audit --prefix frontend && npm audit --prefix backend
scripts.audit:fix: npm audit fix && npm audit fix --prefix frontend && npm audit fix --prefix backend

author: Carolaine Bonk
